evidence.source: synthetic metadata contract derived from a sanitized live observation
sanitization: only fields required for the endpoint contract were retained
tenant, request, session, bucket, and returned-record data were omitted
all timestamps were shifted by one constant offset

metadata.canonicalQuery:
fetch dt.davis.problems.snapshots, from:toTimestamp("2026-06-14T07:50:19.000000000Z"), to:toTimestamp("2026-06-14T10:00:00.000000000Z")
| sort timestamp desc
| dedup event.id
| filter event.start < toTimestamp("2026-06-14T10:00:00.000000000Z") AND coalesce(event.end, toTimestamp("2026-06-14T10:00:00.000000000Z")) >= toTimestamp("2026-06-14T09:00:00.000000000Z")
| fields capture_marker = "synthetic"
| limit 1
